description: This Java class implements the ClientDao interface using Hibernate. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and delete Client entities from the database.

classes.name: ClientDaoImpl
classes.description: Implements data access methods for Client entities using Hibernate, including retrieving, saving, and deleting clients.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieve a Client entity from the database by its ID.

methods.name: saveClient
